name: Death Knight
description: (Tag:dark+)(Tag:martial+)(Tag:necro)(Tag:necro+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)Race Change - You are a Death Knight, an Undead evolved into a far tougher, more physically capable caste. You gain greatly increased physical capabilities and need no rest or sustenance; your energy reserves power all functions. You can naturally use [Necrotic Weapon]. You gain increased Necromancy, Darkness, and Martial affinity, augmenting related abilities, skills, and magic, but you gain vulnerability to Holy- and Light-based abilities and magic. Your energy recovers faster in locations with more negative energy.
